svg.title: Order saga — happy path
svg.desc: Animated sequence of the orchestrated order saga. The client creates an order (status PENDING). order-service publishes OrderCreated; inventory-service reserves stock and publishes InventoryReserved; order-service moves to AWAITING_PAYMENT and publishes PaymentAuthorizationRequested; payment-service authorises with the simulator and publishes PaymentAuthorized; order-service confirms the order and publishes OrderConfirmed, which makes inventory commit the reservation, payment capture the funds and notification-service send the confirmation email.
svg.text: order-service orchestrates; every event is written to the outbox and travels via domain.events
Animated (CSS) · loops every 14 s · Reduced motion: all steps shown · static Mermaid version: docs/architecture/04-order-saga.md
